assumptions: The founder finds and pastes the posts themselves; this workflow never searches or fetches the open web.
Up to 8 posts, each at most 1200 characters.
A drafted reply is a first pass for the founder to edit and post from their own account, never posted automatically.
effects: Writes reports/COMMUNITY_REPLIES.md in the bound project.
Two model calls: one classifies relevance, a second drafts replies only for posts marked relevant.

cases.description: One clearly relevant post and one unrelated post.

inputs.product_pitch: A CLI that summarizes CSV exports for indie founders.
posts: r/smallbusiness: does anyone know a quick way to total up a CSV export without opening Excel?
